name: Ocarina of Time (Ship of Harkinian)
rom_hint: Send your Ocarina of Time ROM with Frame Inbox, or put a .z64 in ~/.local/share/soh.

name: Majora's Mask (2 Ship 2 Harkinian)
rom_hint: Send your Majora's Mask ROM with Frame Inbox, or put a .z64 in ~/.local/share/2ship.
run_sh: # Steam Frame launcher for 2 Ship 2 Harkinian (written by Port Manager). Data, saves and the built mm.o2r
# live in ~/.local/share/2ship, so reinstalling this folder keeps them.
# Hand a ROM shipped next to this script to the extractor until mm.o2r exists.
for rom in "$D"/*.z64; do [ -f "$rom" ] && cp -n "$rom" "$SHIP_HOME/"; done
